topic: Inline Thin-Film Scale-Up Kinetics, Chemical-Potential Windows & TCO Interfacial Reactivity
key_arguments: Evacuated 11 h quartz ampoules prove bulk thermodynamic phase existence, whereas 260-340 nm thin films shorten diffusion paths ~30x (t ~ L^2/D ~ 1000x faster), making <15 min inline CSS/VTD or PVD+RTP at <=380 C kinetically viable on float glass.

BiSbS3 (mp-1227486, SPS=94.76/100) achieves spontaneous formation at 375 C via Bi3+/Sb3+ configurational mixing entropy (-15.49 meV/atom vs +2.30 meV/atom 0 K hull enthalpy -> dG = -13.19 meV/atom), wide sulfur stability window (0.5769 eV), zero oxygen redox sensitivity, and $0.0182/m^2 raw cost; key engineering gate is templating vertical/tilted [hk1] [M4S6]_n ribbons on TiO2.

Sb2OS2 (mp-861911, SPS=94.44/100) sits at 1.10 meV/atom above hull with symmetric 0.4916 eV O/S chemical-potential windows; congruent solid-source PVD/CSS of condensed Sb2O3 + 2 Sb2S3 locks O:S = 1:2 stoichiometrically without toxic H2S/H2O gas drift.
BiInS3 (mp-1078776) is disqualified from terawatt scale-up by Indium criticality (~$300+/kg, competing with ITO) and -$4.50/m^2 criticality surcharge.

Live MP InterfacialReactivity proves bare ITO (In2O3) reacts exothermically at 375 C with Sb2OS2 (-15.35 meV/atom -> Sb2O3 + In2S3), BiSbS3 (-13.16 meV/atom), and CuGaSnSe4 (-68.25 meV/atom), whereas TiO2 (0.00 meV/atom on 8/8 finalists) and SnO2/FTO (0.00 meV/atom on 7/8 finalists) act as mandatory thermodynamic diffusion barriers.

Among Bottom IR scavengers, BiCuS2 (mp-22982, SPS=89.54/100) is hull-stable and earth-abundant ($0.0237/m^2) but requires strictly Cu-poor growth (Cu/Bi ~ 0.94) to stay inside its narrow 0.1063 eV d_mu_Cu window and avoid metallic Cu2-xS shunts.

topic: Red-Team Critique of Status-Quo 3-Layer Sandwich (Path 1) & 2T Monolithic (Path 3) vs. Active Solar Glass (Path 2) & BIPV Beachhead (Path 4)
key_arguments: Path 1 (3-Layer 4T Sandwich) is a near-term commercial trap on commodity bifacial c-Si: a rear 0.75-0.85 eV cell intercepts 20% ground-reflected 300-1100 nm albedo photons and thermalizes them down to ~0.25-0.31 V (at ERE=1e-4) instead of letting unobstructed silicon convert them at ~0.72 V, destroying >55% of rear-albedo voltage.

Standard doped commercial TOPCon/PERC silicon absorbs sub-bandgap IR via Drude free-carrier absorption (exp(-0.38*(lambda/1200)^2)), starving the bottom cell from the front while two-junction PVD/RTP yield compounding (0.90 x 0.86 = 77.4%), >200 bottom-cell laser scribes, and 3-terminal-pair MLPE push module cost to ~$97-$103/m^2 vs $42/m^2 commodity bifacial TOPCon.

Path 3 (2T Monolithic Top-on-Si) breaches SHJ a-Si:H(i) passivation's 220 C thermal ceiling during 375 C sulfidation, forms resistive SiS_x/In2S3 interfacial phases, and suffers diurnal spectral current-matching losses.

Path 4 (Standalone Semi-Transparent BIPV Solar Window Glazing at $185/m^2 ASP vs ~$81.3/m^2 DGU cost -> ~56% gross margin) finances pilot scale-up of the exact same coated front glass needed for Path 2 (2-Layer 4T Active Solar Glass on unobstructed bifacial c-Si, ~$65.9/m^2 at 90% yield).

Mandates 4 Phase-1 hardware kill-gates: Gate K1 (pinhole-free ALD TiO2/SnO2 barrier over ITO with <0.5 Ohm*cm^2 R_c and zero In2S3), Gate K2 (coupon ERE >= 1e-4 and >=83% 700-1100 nm sub-gap transmittance), Gate K3 (picosecond P1/P2/P3 laser scribe R_sh >= 1000 Ohm*cm^2 without metallic Bi0/Sb0 melt shunts), and Gate K4 (<5% degradation after 1000 h 85 C / 85% RH damp-heat + 25 mm hail).

topic: Non-Radiative SRH Voltage Deficit, Bottom-Cell V_oc Collapse & Kesterite Antisite Tailing
key_arguments: Phase 10 radiative efficiencies (42.45% monofacial / 46.17% bifacial) are strict detailed-balance optical upper bounds; real polycrystalline lone-pair chalcogenides operate at ERE ~ 1e-5 to 1e-4, imposing a -V_th*ln(ERE) ~ 0.24-0.30 V non-radiative V_oc deficit from negative-U V_S dimers and Sb_S/Bi_S antisite traps.

A ~0.25-0.31 V total deficit acts asymmetrically across subcells: 1.76-1.79 eV Top Active Glass (Sb2OS2 / BiSbS3) retains ~83% of its radiative V_oc (~1.22-1.25 V, FF_real ~ 0.825), whereas 0.75-0.85 eV Bottom IR cells drop 48-62% in voltage to ~0.20-0.31 V (FF_real ~ 0.58-0.67), slashing real monofacial bottom-cell contribution from +4.8% down to +1.08-1.22% (and +0.51-0.75% at ERE=1e-5).

Quaternary kesterites CuGaSnSe4 and CuInSnSe4 suffer an extra ~110 mV [Cu_Sn + Sn_Cu] electrostatic band-tailing penalty, exothermic In2O3/SnO2 reactions (-36.5 to -68.3 meV/atom), and high sensitivity to +/-0.15 eV HSE06+SOC gap uncertainty (where -0.15 eV drives V_oc < 0.15 V).

Mandates Stage 5 FNV-corrected doped HSE06+SOC supercell calculations across the live MP chemical-potential polygons for V_S (0/+2 dimers), Sb_S/Bi_S antisites in BiSbS3, and O_S/S_O antisites in Sb2OS2.

topic: Architectural Rebuttal on Gen-3 3-Layer Threshold, Dual-Role 48 nm TiO2 Barrier & Staged Horizon 1-3 Consensus Roadmap
key_arguments: Concedes that on commodity bifacial TOPCon/SHJ c-Si (ERE=1e-4, standard Drude FCA), Path 1 drops to 28.30-28.78% bifacial PCE (5.008-5.263 c/kWh) vs Path 2's 30.58-30.61% ($65.88/m^2, 4.234-4.237 c/kWh), while establishing the exact Gen-3 break-even threshold where a 340-391 nm BiCuS2/AgBi3S5 bottom junction becomes viable: ERE >= 5e-3 + custom low-FCA float-zone/intrinsic c-Si + zero-albedo monofacial/aerospace/CPV operation (29.92-29.98% 3L vs 28.85-28.90% 2L).

Demonstrates that the 94 nm MgF2 / 80 nm ITO / 48 nm TiO2 stack solves both the high-index Fresnel reflection problem (R_front cut from 11.9% to 3.2-3.3% while preserving >88.2% sub-gap transmittance) and the newly discovered 375 C In2O3 sulfidation problem (0.00 meV/atom TiO2 reactivity across 8/8 finalists vs -13.2 to -15.3 meV/atom bare ITO).
Confirms 36:72 (BiSbS3, 0.19% mismatch) and 37:72 (Sb2OS2, 1.15-1.18% mismatch) parallel-string laser scribing locks onto the ~50.1 V c-Si bus without 4T DC-DC converter losses.

Locks in the 3-Horizon Consensus Roadmap: Horizon 1 Path 4 BIPV Glazing (11.40-11.62% @ 35% VLT, 58.7% gross margin) -> Horizon 2 Path 2 Drop-In 2L Active Solar Glass on unobstructed bifacial c-Si (30.58-30.61% Bif20, 4.234 c/kWh utility & 6.470 c/kWh rooftop LCOE) -> Horizon 3 Gen-3 Specialty 3L Tandems.
